design.purpose: Make one flat six-point paper snowflake for a window or wall, using one 20 cm square sheet and the photographed scissors.

steps.c: Place the 20 cm square sheet flat.
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner.
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner.
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut straight across the wide end.
Cut a triangular notch from left side.
Cut a triangular notch from right side.
